@tghosth should we make the docker image public? Then it would automatically download for anyone who hadn't built it on their machine. There's a description of the process at the bottom of [this blog post](https://dev.to/willvelida/pushing-container-images-to-github-container-registry-with-github-actions-1m6b).

> Click on the package that you want to make public, then go to Package Settings. In the Danger Zone, click on change visibility and choose Public
![image](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/assets/943641/432565f5-a912-4cb7-b7e6-2c7c8d079a1f)

Our package lives here: https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/pkgs/container/asvs%2Fdocumentbuilder
